findings.title: Vulnerable SQL string interpolation left in disabled code
findings.body: In pkg/expr/sql/parser.go TablesList builds a SQL command with fmt.Sprintf("SELECT json_serialize_sql('%s')", rawSQL) after only doubling single quotes. That is not safe parameterization for a SQL string literal and was part of the SQL-injection / RCE chain via DuckDB. The PR stubs the DB so it is not currently reachable, but the vulnerable construction is left in place. If the stub is ever replaced with a real implementation the injection returns. Disabled security-sensitive code should be removed, not left dormant.

findings.title: Index out of range panic on empty AST
findings.body: In pkg/expr/sql/parser.go function tablesFromAST does flatten.Flatten(ast[0], ...) without checking len(ast). If TablesList ever returns an empty JSON array (e.g. valid SQL with no statement, serialization returning []) the code panics with index out of range, crashing the handler/goroutine and causing denial of service. The caller TablesList never validates that the unmarshalled slice is non-empty before calling it.
